lines.say: What if a volcano woke up at the bottom of the ocean?
Day one. Deep below the waves, the seabed cracks open. Lava meets ice-cold water.
It cools so fast, it forms round blobs called pillow lava. The fish have no idea what is going on.
Eruption after eruption, a mountain grows in the dark. Taller. And taller.
Near the top, the water starts to boil. Huge clouds of steam burst out of the sea.
Then it breaks through. A brand new island is born.
Seabirds land. Seeds wash up on the beach. The first plants take root on the black rock.
This really happened. In nineteen sixty-three, near Iceland, a volcano did it in just days. Its name is Surtsey.
Today, only a few scientists may visit, to watch new life arrive on its own.
Would you visit an island younger than your grandparents? Yes or no?
